title: `trusted_proxies` defaults to empty, empty means the forwarded headers are never read, and a trusted walk takes the rightmost untrusted `X-Forwarded-For` entry
divergesFromPhp: `$_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']` and `HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR` are replaced by one `clientIp(): ?tainted string`, which is the socket peer until an operator names the proxies
